Senior Living Project

A capital project for a new senior residence in Ramallah, replacing a 1970s facility: about 30,000 square feet for 50 or more residents. Ground was broken in October 2023 and the cornerstone laid in June 2024.

Branch
Care · Destinations
Owning entity
Ramallah Foundation, Inc. (Program Architecture), raised through AFRP channels; Program Architecture still asks for confirmation.

Campaign

Who it's for

Donors, and elders as possible residents. Resident eligibility is not stated in the record.

The operating year

Milestones rather than a yearly cycle: groundbreaking October 2023, cornerstone June 2024. Later milestones are not stated.

The five rungs

Not stated in the record for this programme. The five rungs are hear, show up, take part, give or serve, and lead (D25).

Who runs it

Not stated in the record.

Money

A capital campaign with a published $5M goal, in a restricted fund that must never leak into operations; pledges tracked against cash.

Hand-offs

Destination on the Care branch, entered by choice. Elders may live in or fund it; Legacy Giving leads here.
